daily_summary.es: La jornada trae novedades de Apple (iPad de entrada con Apple Intelligence, demanda por Apple Pay, tvOS 27), el fenómeno viral de Muse de Meta y actualizaciones para desarrolladores en Copilot y Ollama.
daily_summary.en: Today brings Apple news (entry-level iPad with Apple Intelligence, Apple Pay lawsuit, tvOS 27), the viral rise of Meta's Muse, and developer updates in Copilot and Ollama.

apple.es: Apple enfrenta una demanda colectiva certificada por presuntas tarifas ilegales de Apple Pay, mientras se filtran detalles del próximo iPad de entrada con chip A19 y Apple Intelligence. Además, Apple publicó por fin las notas de la versión de tvOS 27, y Brent Simmons cuestiona si el 'stock UI' de Mac realmente ahorra trabajo a los desarrolladores.
apple.en: Apple faces a certified class-action lawsuit over alleged illegal Apple Pay fees, while details leak about the next entry-level iPad with an A19 chip and Apple Intelligence. Apple also finally published tvOS 27 release notes, and Brent Simmons questions whether 'stock' Mac UI actually saves developers work.

ai_software.es: El ecosistema de agentes de codificación sigue creciendo: skills.sh alcanzó un millón de skills en siete meses, aunque muy concentrados en pocos paquetes populares. GitHub Copilot añadió nuevos modelos y sandboxing local, y Ollama v0.40.0 ahora ejecuta modelos en MLX de forma nativa en Apple Silicon.
ai_software.en: The coding agent ecosystem keeps growing: skills.sh reached one million skills in seven months, though usage is heavily concentrated in a few popular packages. GitHub Copilot added new models and local sandboxing, and Ollama v0.40.0 now runs models natively on MLX on Apple Silicon.

ai_general.en: The Pentagon is seeking $30 million to build an AI-powered lie detector, betting on scoring algorithms and remote sensing to replace polygraph technology that has barely changed since the 1920s.

title.es: Bancos y cooperativas de crédito se unen contra las comisiones de Apple Pay
title.en: Banks and credit unions team up against Apple Pay fees

body.es: Un juez estadounidense certificó una demanda colectiva que permite a bancos y cooperativas de crédito demandar juntos a Apple por presuntas tarifas ilegales de Apple Pay. La demanda, iniciada en 2022, alega que Apple recauda hasta 1.000 millones de dólares anuales bloqueando el acceso de rivales al chip NFC del iPhone, cobrando un 0,15% en tarjetas de crédito y medio centavo en débito. Esto podría abrir la puerta a alternativas de pago sin contacto en iOS si la demanda prospera.
body.en: A US judge certified a class action allowing banks and credit unions to jointly sue Apple over alleged illegal Apple Pay fees. The suit, filed in 2022, claims Apple collects up to $1 billion annually by blocking rivals from the iPhone's NFC chip, charging a 0.15% fee on credit cards and half a cent on debit cards. This could open the door to alternative tap-to-pay options on iOS if the lawsuit succeeds.

evidence.claim: An antitrust lawsuit against Apple is moving forward, allowing banks and credit unions to sue Apple.
U.S. District Judge Jeffrey White certified a class in the lawsuit, including any U.S. entities that issued payment cards enabled for Apple Pay and paid Apple a fee.
The lawsuit claims Apple illegally collects up to $1 billion annually in fees by preventing rivals from accessing the iPhone's NFC chip.
Apple collects a 0.15 percent fee for credit cards and half a cent for debit cards when a user makes a purchase via Apple Pay.
Apple forces card issuers to pay fees by making Apple Pay the only tap-to-pay option, according to the lawsuit.

title.es: Apple Intelligence llegará al próximo iPad de entrada
title.en: Apple Intelligence is coming to the next entry-level iPad

body.es: Código filtrado revela que el próximo iPad de gama de entrada incluirá un chip A19 y 8GB de RAM, suficiente para soportar Apple Intelligence y las funciones de Siri. También se esperan mejoras de conectividad celular e inalámbrica. Se rumorea un lanzamiento en primavera de 2027 con un precio inicial similar a los 449 dólares del modelo actual.
body.en: Leaked code reveals the next entry-level iPad will include an A19 chip and 8GB of RAM, enough to support Apple Intelligence and Siri features. Faster cellular and wireless connectivity are also expected. Rumors point to a spring 2027 launch with a starting price similar to the current model's $449.

evidence.claim: Apple's next low-cost iPad will include the A19 chip and 8GB of RAM.
The A19 chip supports Apple Intelligence.
The new iPad is expected to have faster cellular and wireless connectivity.
The new iPad is expected to run Apple Intelligence and its Siri features.
The new iPad is rumored to launch in spring 2027 with a starting price likely to match the current model's $449.

title.es: Muse se mantiene como la app número uno del App Store durante una semana
title.en: Muse remains the #1 App Store app for a full week

body.es: El asistente Muse de Meta lleva ya una semana completa en el primer puesto del App Store de iOS, con Meta promocionándolo intensamente en sus propios canales. Su versión de Mac es aún más potente porque puede controlar el equipo directamente, algo que las políticas de la Mac App Store no permiten, por lo que solo se descarga desde la web. El autor admite sentirse incómodo dando a un agente de IA acceso a información tan sensible por ahora.
body.en: Meta's Muse assistant has spent a full week at #1 in the iOS App Store, with Meta heavily promoting it on its own channels. Its Mac version is even more powerful because it can directly control the computer, something Mac App Store policies don't allow, so it's only downloadable from the web. The author admits discomfort granting an AI agent access to such sensitive information for now.

evidence.claim: Muse is the #1 app in the iOS App Store for a full week.
Meta is promoting Muse heavily on its own channels.
The Mac App Store policies prevent apps like Muse from being available in the store.
The author is uncomfortable granting access to personal information to AI agents.

title.es: El estado de las 'skills' de agentes: un millón en siete meses
title.en: State of agent skills: one million in seven months

body.es: skills.sh reporta que su catálogo de skills para agentes de IA alcanzó el millón de unidades en solo siete meses. Sin embargo, la distribución es muy desigual: las 375 skills más populares acaparan el 62% de las instalaciones, mientras que el 98,8% restante se reparte menos del 6%. Esto sugiere que, pese al crecimiento explosivo, muy pocos paquetes concentran el uso real.
body.en: skills.sh reports its catalog of AI agent skills reached one million in just seven months. However, the distribution is highly uneven: the top 375 skills account for 62% of installs, while the remaining 98.8% share less than 6%. This suggests that despite explosive growth, actual usage is concentrated in very few packages.

evidence.claim: skills.sh reached one million skills in seven months.
The top 375 skills account for 62% of installs; the bottom 98.8% share less than 6%.

title.es: El Pentágono pide 30 millones para un detector de mentiras con IA
title.en: The Pentagon wants $30 million for an AI-powered lie detector

body.es: El Departamento de Defensa de EE.UU. busca financiación para Polygraph+ o Polygraph Next, un programa centrado en algoritmos de puntuación con IA y en sensores remotos que puedan medir señales fisiológicas sin contacto físico. La tecnología actual del polígrafo apenas ha cambiado desde los años 20, y estudios indican que los humanos detectan mentiras sin ayuda técnica poco más de la mitad de las veces.
body.en: The US Department of Defense is seeking funding for Polygraph+ or Polygraph Next, a program focused on AI-driven scoring algorithms and remote sensors that can measure physiological signals without physical contact. Current polygraph technology has barely changed since the 1920s, and studies show humans detect lies unaided just over half the time.

evidence.claim: The project will focus on scoring algorithms that use artificial intelligence and machine learning.
Current lie detection technology has barely changed since the polygraph was invented in the 1920s.
Research suggests humans can spot a lie just over half the time without any technical assistance.

title.es: Meta Connect 2026: Zuckerberg presenta su próximo gran lanzamiento
title.en: Meta Connect 2026: Zuckerberg's next big product launch

body.es: El evento anual de productos de Meta se centró en cómo la compañía está 'construyendo un futuro para todos', según palabras de la empresa, en un discurso de Mark Zuckerberg sobre IA y gafas inteligentes. Meta afronta críticas de privacidad y acoso por la cámara integrada en sus gafas, apodadas 'gafas pervertidas', y ya ha intentado responder con ajustes de privacidad y una nueva campaña de marketing.
body.en: Meta's annual product event focused on how the company is 'building a future for everyone,' per Meta's own framing, in a keynote by Mark Zuckerberg about AI and smart glasses. Meta faces privacy and harassment criticism over its glasses' built-in camera, derided as 'pervert glasses,' and has already tried to respond with privacy fixes and a new marketing campaign.

evidence.claim: Meta's annual September product launch event is scheduled to begin at 7PM ET / 4PM PT.
The event will focus on how 'Meta is building a future for everyone'.
Meta is dealing with privacy and harassment concerns related to its smart glasses.
Meta has already attempted to address these concerns with privacy fixes and a new marketing campaign.

title.es: Apple comparte por fin las notas de la versión de tvOS 27
title.en: Apple finally shares tvOS 27 release notes

body.es: Apple publicó las notas de tvOS 27, lanzado el 14 de septiembre, con mejoras en Apple Music, Podcasts y AirPlay, más subtítulos ampliados y la posibilidad de bloquear apps individuales. También añade soporte de texto dinámico en accesibilidad. Es compatible con Apple TV 4K de segunda generación en adelante.
body.en: Apple published the tvOS 27 release notes, for the update released on September 14, adding improvements to Apple Music, Podcasts and AirPlay, expanded captions, and the ability to block individual apps. It also adds Dynamic Text support in Accessibility. It's compatible with Apple TV 4K (2nd generation) and newer.

evidence.claim: Apple released tvOS 27 on Monday, September 14.
tvOS 27 includes enhancements to Apple Music, Podcasts, and AirPlay experiences.
tvOS 27 adds captions to more content and allows blocking individual apps.
Dynamic Text support in Accessibility settings is available in tvOS 27.
tvOS 27 is compatible with Apple TV 4K (2nd generation) and newer.

title.es: GitHub Copilot: novedades semanales del 21 de septiembre

text.es: Las últimas actualizaciones de Copilot añaden nuevos modelos, sandboxing local en la app de Copilot y mejoras en Slack, Microsoft Teams, JetBrains y VS Code.
text.en: The latest Copilot updates add new models, local sandboxing in the Copilot app, and improvements to Slack, Microsoft Teams, JetBrains, and VS Code.

evidence.claim: This week’s releases add new models to Copilot.
Local sandboxing in the Copilot app has been added.
Updates to Copilot have been made in Slack, Microsoft Teams, JetBrains, and VS Code.

title.es: Ollama v0.40.0 ejecuta modelos en MLX por defecto en Apple Silicon
title.en: Ollama v0.40.0 runs models on MLX by default on Apple Silicon

text.es: La nueva versión de Ollama hace que, en dispositivos con Apple Silicon, las arquitecturas de modelos compatibles con MLX se ejecuten automáticamente sobre ese runtime.
text.en: Ollama's new release makes model architectures supported by the MLX runtime automatically run on MLX on Apple Silicon devices.

evidence.claim: Models run on MLX on Apple Silicon by default in the v0.40.0 release.

title.es: Brent Simmons cuestiona el 'stock UI' de Mac

text.es: Simmons argumenta que muchas apps consideradas atractivas no usan interfaz estándar de Mac, y que en su propia app NetNewsWire, con UI muy estándar, adoptar Liquid Glass supuso más trabajo, no menos.
text.en: Simmons argues that many apps widely seen as attractive don't use stock Mac UI, and that in his own app NetNewsWire, which has a very stock UI, adopting Liquid Glass meant more work, not less.

evidence.claim: Many apps people think look good are not using stock UI.
Using stock Mac UI didn’t save developer effort compared to apps with more custom UI.
Users may not care about whether an app is a stock Mac app or not.
The guidance from Apple on how the Mac UI should look is missing the mark.

title.en: Muse looks cute, but looks are deceiving

text.es: El análisis destaca que Muse se presenta como una mascota simpática pese a ser tecnología muy potente, con acceso completo al disco y funcionamiento sobre una VM Linux persistente en la nube de Meta por usuario.
text.en: The analysis notes that Muse is presented as a cute mascot despite being powerful technology, with Full Disk Access and running on a persistent per-user Linux VM in Meta's cloud.

evidence.claim: Muse is presented as a cute mascot despite being powerful cutting-edge technology.
Muse requires clear communication about its Full Disk Access capabilities.
Muse is described as a chatbot that can do things for you.
Muse runs on a persistent Linux VM in Meta’s cloud.
